rejected: Proven reliable monitoring, diagnosis, stillbirth prevention, or replacement for clinical care. Reason: No current results posted; protocol says experimental/non-diagnostic and no anticipated direct benefit. Prevention is an eventual goal.

Current at-home recordings are individually validated against simultaneous ultrasound. Reason: Simultaneous ultrasound describes earlier STUDY00001552 only; current study uses routine ultrasound records for amniotic fluid.
A single consistent current enrollment total. Reason: July 31 protocol says 75 total, 25 per site; September 14 registry says estimated 60 total, 20 per site. Omit film total; retain discrepancy.
A single undisputed prior pilot sample size. Reason: Protocol says 200, registry 205. No reconciliation. Exclude prior sample size and efficacy statistics from film.
A consistent specific extra phone sensor inventory. Reason: Protocol names gyroscope and accelerometer; registry names gyroscope and ambient light sensor. Omit inventory.
The study launched September 14. Reason: That is registry update posting. Actual study start is August 6, 2026.
Only fetal sounds are recorded or the example trace proves fetal health. Reason: All audible sounds are recorded. Prototype screen values are examples, not results or diagnosis.
Womb Watch is a fetal heartbeat monitor. Reason: Sources describe movement, breathing movements and hiccups, not substitution for fetal heart-rate monitoring.
limitations: Both documents are investigator/sponsor-provided primary evidence, not independent efficacy corroboration.
Registry hasResults=false; current clinical benefit and real-world reliability are unestablished.
Protocol screen examples document proposed interface, not patient outcomes.
sentence_audit: PASS for exact bindings recorded in script_audit.json
source: Independent validator; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07626112 registry API and investigator protocol Prot_002.pdf, retrieved 2026-09-29; retained fetches under out/dispatch/sources/validator.
